# Arnaud Legoux Moving Average

*Arnaud Legoux: Gaussian-weighted window with an adjustable centre.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Arnaud Legoux Moving Average** under **Moving averages**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Window size | int | `9` |
| Offset | float | `0.85` |
| Sigma | float | `6` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/alma.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Arnaud Legoux Moving Average", shortTitle: "ALMA", overlay: true });
const length = input.int("Window size", 9, { min: 1 });
const offset = input.float("Offset", 0.85, { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.05 });
const sigma = input.float("Sigma", 6, { min: 0.1, step: 0.5 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
plot(ta.alma(src, length, offset, sigma), { title: "ALMA", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
